introduction: Hey!Thank you so much for watching my stand-up comedy special which was shot in one take in October 2024.You choosing to watch it means so much to me!To fill you in, this was all self-produced.I didn't have any financial backing from producers, agents or managers and financed it all myself from the money I've earnt through doing stand-up comedy.The video is also demonetised because truly I just want people to see it.If you enjoyed this and want to give something, the best thing you could do is come see me at a live show!
